description: Source code for xdiff interface functions, including diff computation, output formatting, and configuration handling within a Git-related project.

methods.name: xdiff_out_hunk
methods.description: Outputs a diff hunk, ensuring it is emitted in the correct context.

methods.name: consume_one
methods.description: Consumes a buffer line by line, calling the line callback.

methods.name: xdiff_outf
methods.description: Outputs diff lines, handling incomplete lines and buffer remainder.

methods.name: trim_common_tail
methods.description: Removes common tail lines from two buffers, ending on a complete line.

methods.name: xdi_diff
methods.description: Computes the diff between two memory-mapped files with optional context trimming.

methods.name: xdi_diff_outf
methods.description: Performs diff and outputs result via callbacks.

methods.name: read_mmfile
methods.description: Reads a file into memory as a mmfile_t structure.

methods.name: read_mmblob
methods.description: Reads a blob object into memory as a mmfile_t structure.

methods.name: buffer_is_binary
methods.description: Checks if a buffer contains binary data.

methods.name: xdiff_set_find_func
methods.description: Sets a find function for diff filtering based on regex patterns.

methods.name: xdiff_clear_find_func
methods.description: Clears the find function and associated resources.

methods.name: xdiff_hash_string
methods.description: Computes a hash for a string with given flags.

methods.name: xdiff_compare_lines
methods.description: Compares two lines with given flags.

methods.name: parse_conflict_style_name
methods.description: Parses a conflict style name string into an internal constant.

methods.name: git_xmerge_config
methods.description: Handles git configuration for merge conflict style.
